name: @fromcode119/next-build-codegen
description: Next.js + build integration for @fromcode119/react-class-components — `.client` directive injection and the Registry-resolved JSX template compiler. Keeps reactor pure React; all build/Next-specific machinery lives here.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@babel/parser --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/cli/next-build-codegen-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@babel/parser --outfile=dist/next-build-codegen-cli.cjs
